entries.title: 电贝斯
entries.description: 两档力度、两次轮换，适合流动低音与稳定根音。
entries.credit: Growlybass and Black And Green Guitars — Karoryfer Lecolds. Guitar recordings: Brian Wood. CC0-1.0

entries.title: 短奏贝斯
entries.description: 较短的起音与尾音，适合切分、跳跃和快节奏伴奏。
entries.credit: Growlybass and Black And Green Guitars — Karoryfer Lecolds. Guitar recordings: Brian Wood. CC0-1.0

entries.title: 干净电吉他
entries.description: 轻重拨弦两档力度，适合分解和弦与城镇主题。
entries.credit: Growlybass and Black And Green Guitars — Karoryfer Lecolds. Guitar recordings: Brian Wood. CC0-1.0

entries.title: 短奏电吉他
entries.description: 利落的短奏与轮换录音，适合节奏型和弦。
entries.credit: Growlybass and Black And Green Guitars — Karoryfer Lecolds. Guitar recordings: Brian Wood. CC0-1.0

entries.title: 钢琴
entries.description: 精选两个力度层与四个根音，适合叙事旋律和和声。
entries.credit: Salamander Grand Piano V3 — Alexander Holm. Retuned mapping: Markus Fiedler. Derived from the user-supplied V3+20161209 44.1 kHz/16-bit distribution. CC-BY-3.0

entries.title: 基础原声鼓组
entries.description: 底鼓、军鼓、闭镲、开镲和通鼓，各有两档力度与轮换。
entries.credit: Gogodze Phu Vol II — Karoryfer Lecolds, copyright 2018. CC-BY-4.0

normalization: RMS -24 dBFS target with peak cap; not perceptual loudness matching.
credits: Growlybass / Black And Green Guitars — Karoryfer Lecolds; guitar recordings Brian Wood (CC0).
Salamander Grand Piano V3 — Alexander Holm; retuned mapping Markus Fiedler (CC BY 3.0).
Gogodze Phu Vol II — Karoryfer Lecolds (CC BY 4.0).
changes: Compact mono 32 kHz edits, trimmed/faded, common instrument gain, selected velocity/RR maps. These are curated derivatives, not full original-library playback.
